cobblemon.species.mawileunyielding.name: Mawile (Unyielding)
cobblemon.species.mawileunyielding.desc: A gentle Mawile with pastel Hatterene colours. Its giant jaw is tied up like a ponytail and only chomps when it feels threatened.
cobblemon.species.ghost_jirachi.name: Ghost Jirachi
cobblemon.species.ghost_jirachi.desc: A wandering wish spirit. Its mint talismans carry forgotten wishes through the night.
cobblemon.species.creepyeon.name: Creepyeon
cobblemon.species.creepyeon.desc: An Eevee that waited for a Trainer who never returned. Its crimson eyes brighten when it hears familiar footsteps. Despite its frightening appearance, it curls beside lost travelers until morning.
cobblemon.species.lunavee.name: Lunavee
cobblemon.species.lunavee.desc: A tiny moonlit Pokemon whose fur sparkles with gentle starlight. It darts through the night and settles beside trusted companions.
cobblemon.species.buzzeon.name: Buzzeon
cobblemon.species.buzzeon.desc: Its antennae detect the faintest scent of flowers. It protects its companions with swift wingbeats and precise strikes from its stinger.
